headline: Goa Cabinet Approves Schemes to Preserve Manuscripts and Oral History
summary: The Goa cabinet has approved four new schemes aimed at preserving historical manuscripts and documenting oral histories across the state.

headline: Goa CARES Cancer Research Study Gets 31 Contractual Appointments
summary: The cabinet has approved 31 contractual positions to support the ongoing Goa CARES cancer research initiative.

headline: Goa Allows Shops and Malls to Operate 24/7
summary: The Goa government has permitted commercial establishments, shops, and malls to stay open 24 hours a day for the next three years.

headline: Goa Government Launches 'Mhajo Flat' Scheme for Unregistered Properties
summary: A new housing initiative called 'Mhajo Flat' has been introduced by the Goa government to assist owners of unregistered flats and properties.

headline: One-Day Goa Assembly Session Scheduled for Dec 16 Draws Opposition Flak
summary: The opposition has strongly criticized the decision to hold a brief one-day Goa Assembly session on December 16, calling it a mockery of democracy.

headline: Congress and GFP Begin Alliance Talks for 2027 Goa Polls
summary: The Congress party and the Goa Forward Party have initiated discussions regarding a potential alliance for the upcoming 2027 assembly elections.

headline: IFFI 2026 to Screen Over 230 Films with Spain as Country of Honour
summary: The upcoming IFFI will feature screenings of more than 230 films, with Spain participating as the official Country of Honour.

headline: New Scenic Vande Bharat Express Connects Bengaluru to Goa
summary: Travelers can now experience one of India's newest and most scenic rail routes via the Vande Bharat Express connecting Bengaluru and Goa.

headline: Goa Teacher Booked Under POCSO for Stalking Minor Student
summary: Police have filed a POCSO case and arrested a teacher in Bicholim following allegations of stalking and harassing a minor student.

headline: Goa's Rabies Elimination Blueprint Serves as Model for Tamil Nadu
summary: Tamil Nadu has drawn inspiration from Goa's successful rabies elimination strategy to implement similar public health measures.

headline: Man Sentenced to 12 Years for 2018 Palolem Rape of British Tourist
summary: A court in Goa has sentenced a Chennai man to 12 years in prison for raping a British tourist in Palolem back in 2018.

headline: Borkar Issues Legal Notice to Goa CEO Over Address Dispute
summary: A legal notice has been served to the Goa Chief Electoral Officer by MLA Borkar, citing concerns over an address dispute and biased treatment.

headline: Goa Cabinet Sanctions Rs 10 Crore Under New AI Policy Schemes
summary: The state cabinet has approved five new schemes under its artificial intelligence policy, backed by a financial sanction of Rs 10 crore.

headline: New QR-Enabled Guide Documents Over 500 Bird Species in Goa
summary: Goa's avian population is now featured in a comprehensive new QR-enabled guide showcasing 507 different bird species.

headline: AAP MP Sanjay Singh Vows to Raise Mormugao Coal Dust Issue in Parliament
summary: Aam Aadmi Party leader Sanjay Singh has announced plans to raise concerns regarding coal dust pollution in Mormugao during parliamentary sessions.

headline: NCC Cadets Embark on 220km Maritime Expedition from Karwar to Goa
summary: A total of 72 NCC cadets are participating in a 220-kilometer sailing expedition along the coast from Karwar to Goa.

headline: Digital Tracking Made Mandatory for Used Cooking Oil Transactions in Goa
summary: Authorities in Goa have implemented compulsory digital tracking for all commercial transactions involving used cooking oil.

headline: Three Arrested in Colva for Attempted Murder
summary: Goa police have taken three individuals into custody following an attempted murder incident reported in Colva.

headline: Mandrem and Galgibaga Beaches Contemplate Blue Flag Certification
summary: Mandrem and Galgibaga beaches in Goa are being eyed for prestigious Blue Flag international eco-labels for the 2026-27 period.

headline: Mapusa Parking Contractor Serviced Notice Over Alleged Overcharging
summary: The KTC has issued a notice to the parking contractor at the Mapusa bus stand following complaints of overcharging visitors.
